- **The browser extension connects again.** 0.3.0 and 0.3.1 never got past
  "Connecting…" because of a bug introduced with the Web Store build. Update the
  extension: download `relay-extension-0.3.2.zip`, unzip it over the same
  folder and press Reload.
- **Skipper Screen fits tablets.** In landscape on a tablet the QR code no
  longer fills the screen: it has a fixed size, and wide screens get two
  columns.
- **The remote shows its version and checks for updates.** A banner appears
  when a new release is out, and *Settings → Informazioni* shows the installed
  version.
- The extension popup explains how it works and where to get the phone app.
